question: Estimate the number of broadband (wired + fixed wireless) connections in India.
idealClarificationQuestions: Fixed broadband connections (wired fiber + DSL + fixed wireless)? Yes.
Excludes mobile broadband subscribers? Yes — fixed only.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: TRAI fixed broadband subscriber base (FY26): ~5 crore (rapid growth from 3.5 crore in FY24 due to Jio AirFiber, Airtel Xstream Fiber push).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
